# ractermx_reputation_score (Data Source)

Reads the outbound email reputation score for a RacterMX domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `composite_score` (Number) The composite reputation score (0-100).
- `computed_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the score was computed.
- `grade` (String) The reputation grade (A-F).
- `insufficient_data` (Boolean) True if there is not enough outbound activity to compute a score.
- `is_degraded` (Boolean) Whether the reputation is currently degraded.
- `total_sent` (Number) Total emails sent in the scoring window.
